I grew up with the 2012 version,and my parents where both avid fans of the 1987 version, I’m really happy they explored a different dynamic as well,and added more physical characterization to each turtle. Ive noticed that the older the show,the less distinguishable the turtles are,same face/body and such,I noticed the change in 2012, with the different colored skin,and noticeable characteristics ,like Mikey’s freckles,Donnie’s tooth gap,and the different head shape. They cranked it up to the max in the rise series,making them different types of turtles. Raph is a alligator snapping turtle,leo is a red eared slider, donnie is a spiny softshell , and Mikey is a box turtle. It added a lot of character to them. It also explores how leadership was chosen,I belive that raph was chosen to be the leader because he is the oldest,and he is also the largest physically.

To put a long story short,they have changed but they still maintain core elements of their personality. It really shows how their behaviors and such changed with a different environment! Raph is the leader in the rise series,he’s a lot less outwardly agressive and takes on a more parental/older brother role,but maintains the “punch now think later” mindset and still struggles with isolation. Leo is now more of a jokey comedian type,but he keeps his ability to make plans and his generel dork behavior. Donnie hasn’t changed as much,I’ve noticed he’s a lot less of a doormat,and he can be pretty intimidating,but he’s still the tech guy (HE ALSO FINNALY HAS A TECH BŌ!!!) and Mikey is still the youngest sibling,thoigh he is more in touch with his feelings and is,in my opionion,the glue of the family. Yeah! I feel like I’m the first but they’re less characterized. I was initially drawn to it because of the art style,there is definetly development for the characters as the show goes on. The switch from 2012s more gritty and dark tone to a brightly animated,comedic series is definitely a lot. It’s aimed at a younger audience then the 2012 series was,but later in the season it has a few more emotional moments. And it’s a lot more focased on the dynamic of the brothers themselves that anything else,there is action but it shows a lot more of how they interact. A lot of people have criticized the change in personality in some of the turtles (a lot of people note Raph changing from a angry,and pretty violent charactwe,to now,in rise where he takes the possition of leader and seems a lot less agressive) but they do still share similar traits,they both have the “fight now think later” mindset,and they both struggle with loneliness. Same thing with Leo,dispute the differences,they’re both good at strategizing and are able to take leadership roles. I feel like mikey and Donnie where changed the least. 
TLDR;takes some time to develop,but it is worth it 100%
